GAB.note: Document states nothing on state data control.
Only advocacy for national IXPs; no Gabon exchange point stated in service.
No shared cable, exchange or storage facility named; roadmap on IXPs is intent.
No African legal text signed, ratified or transposed is named.

facts.fact: Gabon's regulator ARCEP, as One Africa Network lead country, took part in the 2-4 June 2026 ECOWAS, ARTAO and Smart Africa workshop in Lagos, and the document says the DRC joined the OAN in April 2026 by signing a bilateral memorandum of understanding.

ARCEP Gabon reports free roaming in the CEMAC zone covers 100% of operators in Congo and Equatorial Guinea, 87% in Cameroon, 85% in the Central African Republic and 83% in Chad, and a 91% overall OAN implementation rate for Gabon.
